column1: # Altin Peak: the miner's condition after the rescue.

column3:
I heard the roof crack.
I thought we'd die
under that stone.{page_break}My hands won't stop
shaking.{end_wait}
He's still shaking.\nGive him a moment.\nDon't crowd him.{end_wait}
The others got out.\nBut he can barely\nstand.{end_wait}
Can you stay\nuntil I can walk?{end_now}
Thank you.\nI just need a moment.\nThen I'll be ready.{end_wait}
The roof's not safe.\nLet's help him walk\noutside.{end_wait}
